summary: GSK plc and GlaxoSmithKline Capital Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing legal opinions (Exhibits 5.1, 5.2) from Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton LLP tied to an F-3 registration statement. The opinions cover a guaranteed debt offering by GSK Capital Inc.: $1.25bn 4.850% notes due 2029, $1.25bn 5.000% notes due 2031, $1.5bn 5.250% notes due 2033, $1.5bn 5.500% notes due 2036, $500m 6.000% notes due 2056, and $500m floating-rate notes due 2029, guaranteed by GSK plc. This is a routine shelf takedown with no special-situation element; watch nothing beyond ordinary credit spread and rate risk.
